description: Natural-language exploration of Daiichi Sankyo oncology Medical Affairs omnichannel engagement: MSL priorities, HCP 360, scientific topic interest, medical inquiry SLAs, congress activity, and territory opportunity. All data is synthetic and non-promotional.
sample_questions: Which high-priority HCPs are under-engaged and overdue for an MSL visit?
What are the top scientific topics of interest across oncology KOLs?
Which territories have the lowest 90-day HCP reach rate?
How many medical inquiries are overdue and what is the average response time?
List the Tier 1 KOLs with open medical inquiries about Safety / ILD Management
What is the SLA-met percentage for medical inquiries by product?
notes: Metric views (metric_hcp_engagement, metric_medical_inquiries) provide governed measure definitions so Genie answers match the dashboard and app. Repoint warehouse_id on import. See evidence/07_genie_nl_query.md for a verified live query.
